SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
"t0"."name" AS "name",
"t0"."weight" AS "weight",
"t0"."present" AS "present",
"t0"."called" AS "called",
"t0"."unit" AS "unit",
"t0"."email" AS "email",
"t0"."delegate_id" AS "delegate_id",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."id" WHEN "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."delegate_id" ELSE NULL END ) AS "represented_by",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 OR "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END ) AS "represented_weight"
 FROM "main"."assembly_person" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."assembly_person" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."delegate_id")="t1"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."unit","t0"."id"

request.columns: SUM($present) AS present,SUM($represented_weight) AS weight,SUM($weight) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN $represented_weight>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS represented

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
"t0"."name" AS "name",
"t0"."weight" AS "weight",
"t0"."present" AS "present",
"t0"."called" AS "called",
"t0"."unit" AS "unit",
"t0"."email" AS "email",
"t0"."delegate_id" AS "delegate_id",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."id" WHEN "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."delegate_id" ELSE NULL END ) AS "represented_by",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 OR "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END ) AS "represented_weight"
 FROM "main"."assembly_person" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."assembly_person" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."delegate_id")="t1"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."unit","t0"."id"

request.columns: SUM($present) AS present,SUM($represented_weight) AS weight,SUM($weight) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN $represented_weight>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS represented

 FROM "main"."assembly_person" AS "t0"

request.columns: $ballot_id,$representative_id,COUNT(*) AS represented,SUM($weight) AS weight,SUM(CASE WHEN $person_id<>$representative_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delegates,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
"t0"."name" AS "name",
"t0"."weight" AS "weight",
"t0"."present" AS "present",
"t0"."called" AS "called",
"t0"."unit" AS "unit",
"t0"."email" AS "email",
"t0"."delegate_id" AS "delegate_id",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."id" WHEN "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."delegate_id" ELSE NULL END ) AS "represented_by",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 OR "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END ) AS "represented_weight"
 FROM "main"."assembly_person" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."assembly_person" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."delegate_id")="t1"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."unit","t0"."id"

request.columns: SUM($present) AS present,SUM($represented_weight) AS weight,SUM($weight) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN $represented_weight>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS represented

compiled.sql:
SELECT SUM("t0"."present") AS present,
SUM(( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 OR "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END )) AS weight,
SUM("t0"."weight") AS total,
SUM(CASE WHEN ( CASE WHEN "t0"."present"=1 OR "t1"."present"=1 THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END )>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS represented
 FROM "main"."assembly_person" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."assembly_person" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."delegate_id")="t1"."id")

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
"t0"."ballot_id" AS "ballot_id",
"t0"."person_id" AS "person_id",
"t0"."representative_id" AS "representative_id",
"t0"."weight" AS "weight",
"t0"."choice" AS "choice"
 FROM "main"."assembly_vote" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

request.columns: $ballot_id,$representative_id,COUNT(*) AS represented,SUM($weight) AS weight,SUM(CASE WHEN $person_id<>$representative_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delegates,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending

compiled.sql:
SELECT "t0"."ballot_id" AS "ballot_id",
"t0"."representative_id" AS "representative_id",
COUNT(*) AS represented,
SUM("t0"."weight") AS weight,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."person_id"<>"t0"."representative_id" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delegates,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."choice" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending
 FROM "main"."assembly_vote" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."ballot_id","t0"."representative_id"
ORDER BY "t0"."ballot_id","t0"."representative_id"

request.columns: $ballot_id,COUNT(*) AS represented,SUM($weight) AS weight,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice='yes' THEN $weight ELSE 0 END) AS yes,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice='no' THEN $weight ELSE 0 END) AS no,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice='abstain' THEN $weight ELSE 0 END) AS abstain,SUM(CASE WHEN $choice IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending

compiled.sql:
SELECT "t0"."ballot_id" AS "ballot_id",
COUNT(*) AS represented,
SUM("t0"."weight") AS weight,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."choice"='yes' THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END) AS yes,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."choice"='no' THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END) AS no,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."choice"='abstain' THEN "t0"."weight" ELSE 0 END) AS abstain,
SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."choice" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending
 FROM "main"."assembly_vote" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."ballot_id"
ORDER BY "t0"."ballot_id"
